name: Dynamic Appearance Features Modeling
aliases: Adaptive Sampling with K Feature Maps
definition: A technique to model varying environmental influences (light, weather) on Gaussian points by extracting dynamic appearance features from a reference image, addressing the limitation of global feature embeddings that assume uniform environmental information.
summary: Dynamic Appearance Features Modeling captures local lighting details in 3D Gaussian Splatting by sampling from multiple feature maps, unlike global embedding methods.
